FR-001.title: Show a single non-blocking dismissable install hint when dispatching a stock speckit command to a terminal-CLI provider

FR-002.title: Gate identically to in-editor nudges: spec-kit detected AND companion not installed AND not dismissed

FR-003.title: Do not show for in-editor chat/panel providers (already covered by #543)

FR-004.title: Reuse existing install infra; no parallel nudge system

FR-005.title: Shared dismissal honored in both directions (editor <-> terminal)

FR-006.title: Hint shown at most once per session plus permanent suppression on dismiss

FR-007.title: Never block, delay, or fail the dispatched command

FR-008.title: Telemetry shown gated on the same render condition with surface label terminal

FR-009.title: Acting on the hint runs one-click install and records a terminal-surface conversion

context: area: src/ai-providers (terminal vs editor provider classification)
constraint: reuse #543 install-nudge infra, shared installNudgeDismissed
constraint: extension isolation — src/ + prompt text only
intent: Give terminal-CLI users a single quiet dismissable hint to install the companion extension, matching #543's in-editor nudges
expectations: No new nudge system — reuse existing install commands and dismissal state
No editing of .claude/** or .specify/** to implement the feature
No change to the existing companion->stock fallback warning surface
approach: Reuse the #543 install-nudge infra (install command, shared installNudgeDismissed, isCompanionInstalled) behind a pure gate predicate and a terminal-vs-editor provider classifier; wire a non-blocking notification into the terminal stock-command dispatch chokepoints, gated identically and telemetered with a terminal surface label.

decisions.decision: Non-blocking VS Code notification as the surface
decisions.why: Reuses #543 infra verbatim, stays dismissable and out of the run
decisions.rejected: Prepending a hint to the dispatched prompt (not dismissable, mutates the command, repeats every dispatch)

decisions.decision: Classify providers via an editor-provider set with a neutral terminal default
decisions.why: In-editor providers already have #543 nudges; new CLI providers stay nudge-eligible by default
decisions.rejected: A dispatchTarget field on all 11 ProviderPaths entries (larger diff, gold-plating for scope)

decisions.decision: Skip the nudge when the companion->stock fallback already warned
decisions.why: Avoid two notifications for one dispatch; the new nudge targets the stock-workflow case the fallback never covers
decisions.rejected: Suppressing the fallback warning in favor of the generic hint

plan.summary: Plan reuses #543 install-nudge infra behind a pure gate + provider classifier, wired into terminal dispatch
plan.key_finding: spec-kit detection = .specify presence; the stock-workflow terminal dispatch is the case with no existing nudge (fallback only covers companion->stock)

tasks.summary: 10 tasks across Foundational + 3 story phases + Polish; wave-grouped, ends with suite-run validation
